name: Block Swoosh
description: The later pedal, its feedback resistor in, at a moderate rate: peaks beside the notches give the sweep a vowel. The lead sound of the late 1970s rock records.

name: Electric Piano Shimmer
description: Slow, at three quarters of the circuit's swing, the stages a little under the input: the gentle movement a tine piano was given in the 1970s.

name: Rotary Wobble
description: The knob turned up past three o'clock: a fast warble for electric pianos and organs, standing in for a rotating speaker.

name: Slow Swirl
description: The earlier pedal with its knob low: the two notches climb and fall every two seconds, quick through the lows and lingering above. Clean or crunchy guitar, rhythm parts, the funk of the 1970s.

name: Still Notch
description: The oscillator held still at the middle of the sweep with the feedback in: two fixed notches and their peaks, a comb-like colour to sit a part in a mix.

name: Vibrato Stages
description: The stages alone, without the input: no notches, only the phase moving, heard as a vibrato. The modification players made to the pedal to turn it into one.
